notes: Fixed two live-found bugs where per-account KPIs (shipped last release) never changed when switching customers: the Official AIQ Health Score tile, and the TAM Recommendations Score %. Both only ever fetched one account-wide figure; both now fetch a real per-customer value (summary(nagpId:...) / recommendations(customerId:...) -- confirmed live, 28/29 and 36/36 real customers respectively reported genuinely different scores), used everywhere each figure appears (KPI tile, TAM Recommendations tab + TXT export, QBR Pack, Risk & Remediation Brief, CSM Value Insights), falling back to an honestly-labeled account-wide figure only when no single customer is in scope. Also fixed a real crash bug in Switch Validation (connected-device port entries with no status/model were treated as firmware alerts, crashing on an undefined .toLowerCase() call) and applied ~15 fixes from a 4-agent tool-wide MSP/SAM/TAM accuracy audit: fabricated SAM tab claims removed, a 'Not Set' placeholder no longer leaks into name lists, Security Advisories no longer defaults unknown severity to 'medium', a firmware-baseline prefix-matching bug (IOM12 vs IOM12G) fixed, DR 'Unprotected Systems' no longer double-counts SyncMirror, 5 Action Planner tab tooltips rewritten to match real content, As-Built Document field-name and truthy-array bugs fixed, OS Upgrade heuristic guidance now visibly disclaimed instead of presented as a confirmed Active IQ recommendation, and Support Cases now caps its render instead of showing every case ever opened with no limit.
